title: Follow up an unpaid invoice
summary: When you send an invoice, wait a few days, check with Paystack whether it was paid, and text the customer a reminder if not.
description: Gives your invoicing tool a signed web address. For each invoice it sends (invoice number, Paystack payment reference, customer phone, amount in naira), waits the number of days you choose, checks with Paystack whether the payment came in, and texts the customer a reminder only if it has not. Paid invoices get no message.

params.name: wait_days
params.title: Days to wait
params.description: How many days after the invoice to check and remind.

params.name: path
params.title: Web address path
params.description: The path your invoicing tool calls.

params.name: paystack_connection
params.title: Paystack connection
params.description: The name of your Paystack connection.

params.name: sms_connection
params.title: Termii connection
params.description: The name of your Termii connection.

steps.name: Give the customer time to pay
Check with Paystack whether it was paid
Nothing to do: the invoice is paid

input.sms: =steps.settings.output.business_name + ': a reminder that invoice ' + trigger.body.invoice_number + ' for NGN ' + string(trigger.body.amount_naira) + ' is still unpaid. Thank you.'
